scientific_queries.note: Attempted cross-dataset replication on BATCHIE's dose-aware residual arena; the run was invalid.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round fails technically, refuses to use its own numbers, and records why.

compute.first_run: killed after ~40 minutes because RidgeCV inside a 10-block loop was too slow

invalid_evidence.symptom_1: identity and identity+gene agree to four decimals with a zero-width confidence interval
invalid_evidence.symptom_2: both are 13.59% while a bottom-quartile target has a 25% base rate, i.e. far below chance
invalid_evidence.symptom_3: the random capacity control scores 27.81%, about chance, and beats both real arms

technical_cause.change_1: RidgeCV replaced by a closed-form solve at a fixed alpha for speed
technical_cause.change_2: the gene block was left at 4,889 dimensions instead of a restricted set, so at that alpha its coefficients were flattened
technical_cause.change_3: the training residual came from an in-sample fit while the held-out residual came from an out-of-sample fit, making their scales incomparable
technical_cause.result: the ranking became anti-correlated with the target, reproducing none of the R88/R89 behaviour
technical_cause.all_three_changes_at_once: this is why the failure could not be attributed to a single cause

decisions.H271: not established - the automated verdict is withdrawn

promotion_status.leakage_review: favourable but the pre-registered gate failed in the small pool (C76)
promotion_status.cross_dataset: unresolved; this round produced nothing usable

lesson: changing a validated pipeline in three places at once to save time is the worst version of this mistake; the right move is one change at a time, checked against a known number on a small sample before scaling up
next_gates: return to the R88/R89 implementation (RidgeCV, restricted gene set), add only an identity arm, and first check on a small sample that the gene arm still reproduces about 28% before scaling
limits: no comparable numbers were produced this round
the BATCHIE residual arena was usable in R88/R89; this round's rewrite is what broke
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
